data.narrative:
Union, a Defense & Security seed-stage company founded by Will Somerindyke, Jon Reiland, and Joe Musselman, has raised $51.3M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers spanning both public equities (2 names: DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private companies including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic across seed and Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $51.3M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $128M. Peer-median analysis draws from four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—with a median valuation of $700M and a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $109M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $414M. The wide dispersion reflects substantial heterogeneity within the peer set, particularly the $4.0B outlier (Stark Defence) and the presence of both early-stage and Series A comparables. Key uncertainties include Union's product maturity relative to UFORCE and other seed-stage peers, customer traction, and defensibility within a crowded frontier-defense landscape. The median estimate of $414M sits meaningfully above the stage-progression anchor but substantially below the peer median, reflecting Union's early stage relative to the broader comp set.
